description:
Activate Ziatora's Proving Ground's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
Bone Miser and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Golgari Findbroker.
Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, returning Ziatora's Proving Ground from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ziatora's Proving Ground ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
